zh: 翻译页改成上下双卡。上面输入文字、录音或选图，下面查看译文。底部可切换文字、语音和拍照，最近翻译从右上角打开。
en: Translation now has an input card above the result card. Add text, a recording, or a photo at the top and see the translation below. Switch modes at the bottom and open recent translations from the top right.

zh: 与构建 50 相比，切换输入方式会保留文字草稿，打开最近翻译会保留当前结果。照片译文仍逐行对照。
en: Compared with build 50, switching input modes keeps your text draft. Opening recent translations keeps the current result. Photo translations remain paired line by line.

zh: 核对上下双卡、互换语言、切换输入方式和打开最近翻译。用「完成」、点空白和上滑收起键盘，确认草稿仍在。核对聊天、行程、插件、记忆的顺序。
账号开通后，文字中英各三条，语音中英各三次（含无声录音），再测菜单、路牌、小票、药品说明各三张照片。
抽测构建 49 的第 1、3、4 项。强退重开恢复旧对话和草稿，历史打开旧和新对话，切后台 10 秒及锁屏 60 秒后恢复。
en: Check the two cards, language swap, mode switching and recent translations. Use Done, tap an empty spot and swipe up to dismiss the keyboard. Verify that the text draft stays and the tabs appear in Chat, Trips, Tools, Memory order.
Once your account is enabled, translate three texts and three recordings in each direction, including a silent recording. Test three photos each of menus, signs, receipts, and medicine instructions.
Repeat build 49 checks 1, 3, and 4. Restore an older chat and draft after a force-quit, open both chats from history, then return after 10 seconds in the background and 60 seconds locked.

title.en: Known issues and checks to avoid
title.zh: 已知问题和暂不测试内容

zh: 翻译需要联网。真实千问翻译等账号开通后再测。
en: Translation requires an internet connection. Wait until your account is enabled before checking live translation.

zh: 本版调整翻译页面。账号资格与真实翻译复测通知见 #1274。
en: This build updates the Translation screen. See #1274 for account enablement and the live translation retest.

zh: 更新语音录音入口，修复打开语音输入时的闪退。翻译页可用右上角「完成」、点空白或上滑收起键盘。
顺序为聊天、行程、插件、记忆。邀请码与记忆编辑也可用「完成」收起键盘。
en: Updated the recording entry to address the crash when opening voice input. In Translation, tap Done at the top right, tap an empty spot, or swipe up to dismiss the keyboard.
The tabs are Chat, Trips, Tools, and Memory. Done also dismisses the keyboard on the invitation and memory editing screens.

zh: 与构建 49 相比，翻译使用千问和香港翻译服务，需要联网。语音和照片上传后显示「正在识别并翻译…」。
en: Compared with build 49, translation uses Qwen through the Hong Kong translation service and requires an internet connection. After sending audio or a photo, the app shows “Recognizing and translating…”.

zh: 打开「插件 → 翻译」，点语音入口，核对不闪退。打开录音后可切后台结束这次录音。
翻译页输入几字，分别用「完成」、点空白和上滑收起键盘，确认输入保留、按钮位置正常。核对四个底部入口的顺序。
抽测构建 49 的第 1、3、4 项：强退重开恢复旧对话和草稿，历史分别打开旧和新对话，切后台 10 秒及锁屏 60 秒后恢复。
en: Open Tools → Translation and tap voice input. Check that the app stays open. You can leave the app in the background to end the recording.
Enter a few words in Translation. Dismiss the keyboard with Done, an empty-area tap, and an upward swipe. Check that the draft and buttons stay in place. Check the four tabs in order.
Repeat build 49 checks 1, 3, and 4: force-quit and restore an older chat and its draft, open both chats from history, then return after 10 seconds in the background and 60 seconds locked.

title.en: Known issues and checks to avoid
title.zh: 已知问题和暂不测试内容

zh: 真实翻译等账号开通通知后再测。收到通知后，文字中英各三条、语音中英各三次（含无声录音），并用菜单、路牌、小票和药品说明各三张照片核对结果。
en: Wait until your account is enabled before checking live translation. When notified, translate three texts and three recordings in each direction, including a silent recording, and test three photos each of menus, signs, receipts, and medicine instructions.

zh: 本次先核对 App 操作。服务可用后会在 #1274 补发真实翻译复测通知。
en: This round focuses on app interactions. See #1274 for the live translation retest notice once the service is enabled.
